title: A "knob-in-hole" gate in the antibody C(H)1 domain underlies subclass-independent IgA hinge cleavage by the commensal metallopeptidase IgAse.
authors: Sebastian Ramirez-Larrota, Juan; Estivill, Guillem Arasa; Lopez-Martin, Mario; Effantin, Gregory; Gragera, Marcos; Sorzano, Carlos Oscar Sanchez; Marcos, Enrique; Eckhard, Ulrich; Gomis-Ruth, Francesc Xavier
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜和分子动力学研究IgAse蛋白酶切割IgA抗体的结构机制，虽以蛋白-蛋白相互作用和酶切机制为核心，但涉及蛋白质结构解析与MD模拟，对蛋白结构计算课题有参考价值。
abstract: Human immunoglobulin (Ig) A (IgA) protects  approximately 400 m(2) of mucosae from microbes. Bacterial IgA-peptidases subvert this defense by cleaving the F(ab)-F(c) hinge of subclass IgA1 while sparing the hinge-divergent, colon-dominant IgA2 subclass. The exception is IgAse, a  approximately 140-kDa, seven-domain, membrane-bound metallopeptidase from the colonic commensal Thomasclavelia ramosa that targets both subclasses but no other protein. We previously narrowed the minimal functional assembly down to the IgAse catalytic and wrapping domains (CD and WD) plus the IgA1/2 F(ab)', i.e., the hinge and a F(ab) of light and heavy chains (LC, HC), each with a variable and a constant Ig domain (V(L) + C(L), V(H) + C(H)1). The transient interaction culminates in cleavage of a proline-valine bond within the first two hinge residues, downstream of a conserved C-terminal C(H)1 disulfide (SS2). Here, single-particle cryoelectron microscopy of a disulfide-stabilized minimal IgAse:IgA2 F(ab)' complex yielded high-quality density strongly supporting two states along the cleavage reaction coordinate, a "recognition complex" and a subsequent "precatalytic complex," in which F(ab)' binds frontally to the IgAse CD via a C(H)1 beta-sheet and overhang loop LbetaEbetaF. This loop binds like a knob to a preformed hole in the active-site cleft. Binding rearranges the knob and rotates SS2  approximately  180 degrees , enabling access of the hinge into the cleft of the otherwise unaffected precatalytic complex. Together, this work defines a unique, C(H)1-mediated hinge-delivering "gate" mechanism, validated by a crystal structure of unbound IgA2 F(ab), point mutations disrupting the C(H)1:CD interface, and molecular dynamics calculations, which provide the structural framework for subclass-independent IgA cleavage.
abstract_zh: 人免疫球蛋白（Ig）A（IgA）保护约400平方米的黏膜免受微生物侵害。细菌IgA肽酶通过切割IgA1亚类的F(ab)-F(c)铰链区来破坏这一防御，同时保留铰链区差异显著、在结肠中占主导的IgA2亚类。例外的是IgAse，一种来自结肠共生菌Thomasclavelia ramosa的约140 kDa、七结构域、膜结合金属肽酶，它靶向两个亚类但不作用于其他蛋白质。我们先前将最小功能组装体缩小至IgAse催化结构域和包裹结构域（CD和WD）加上IgA1/2 F(ab)'，即铰链区和轻链、重链（LC、HC）的F(ab)，每条链各含一个可变区和一个恒定区免疫球蛋白结构域（V(L) + C(L)，V(H) + C(H)1）。这种瞬时相互作用最终导致铰链区前两个残基内脯氨酸-缬氨酸键的切割，该键位于保守的C端C(H)1二硫键（SS2）下游。在此，对二硫键稳定的最小IgAse:IgA2 F(ab)'复合物进行单颗粒冷冻电子显微镜分析，获得了高质量密度图，强烈支持沿切割反应坐标的两个状态，即“识别复合物”和随后的“预催化复合物”，其中F(ab)'通过C(H)1β-折叠和突出环LβEβF正面结合至IgAse CD。该环像旋钮一样插入活性位点裂隙中预先形成的孔洞。结合使旋钮重排并将SS2旋转约180度，从而使铰链区能够进入裂隙，而预催化复合物的其余部分不受影响。总之，这项工作定义了一种独特的、由C(H)1介导的铰链递送“门”机制，并通过未结合IgA2 F(ab)的晶体结构、破坏C(H)1:CD界面的点突变以及分子动力学计算得到验证，为亚类非依赖性IgA切割提供了结构框架。
